observation: The official NRL judiciary report, updated Monday 14 September 2026 at 6:07pm AEST, records Adam Pompey as guilty by early plea for a Grade 1 Shoulder Charge, second offence, with a $3000 fine. NRL.com states he escaped suspension and is free to line up in the sudden-death semi-final.
audit_note: Judiciary clearance is not equivalent to official Week 2 selection, injury clearance or guaranteed availability. No causal performance uplift is inferred.
